title: Poland's cybersecurity plenipotentiary creates a team on DDoS protection for entities important to national cybersecurity, chaired by UKE head, Telko.in reports
date_note: Telko.in (27 Nov) says the ordinance was signed 'last Wednesday' and took effect on 27 November; the page's own publication day is used.
org: Office of Electronic Communications (UKE) / Ministry of Digital Affairs
geo_basis: Warsaw, seat of the Polish government and UKE; the source names no city
summary: Telko.in reports that Krzysztof Gawkowski, Poland's Government Plenipotentiary for Cybersecurity and Minister of Digital Affairs, issued an ordinance creating a team to protect entities important for Polish cybersecurity from DDoS attacks. The UKE president chairs it, with members from ABW, MON, the Police and NASK. It is to propose short-term and systemic solutions. The article notes the telecom sector has faced DDoS attacks since the start of 2026, mainly aimed at extortion.
plain: Poland has set up a government team, led by the telecoms regulator's head, to work out how to protect important organisations from DDoS attacks, according to Telko.in.
exec: Poland is formalising a state response to DDoS attacks, which Telko.in says have hit its telecom sector since early 2026.

sources.name: Telko.in: Prezes UKE pokieruje zespołem do walki z DDoS-ami
